chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Golden Chickpea Goes Cold

scenes.caption: Garbanzo celebrates a savings transfer while the copper pot rattles cold.
scenes.alt: In a bright New Jersey kitchen, palm-sized chickpea-shaped robot Garbanzo pops shiny gold confetti straight into Jorge's coffee mug while Marissa holds pancakes out of Jorge's reach and six-year-old Clara in purple unicorn socks points toward a chilly, unlit copper pot beside the toaster.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Train Home and the Crayon Warning

scenes.caption: Saturday morning math on the yellow legal pad, with Garbanzo in mug timeout.
scenes.alt: At the Saturday dining table covered with a large unfolded map of Spain and a yellow legal pad, Jorge and Marissa compare real numbers over coffee while tiny Garbanzo peeks dramatically out from beneath an upside-down ceramic mug and the copper pot glows warm gold behind them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Clara's Rules and a Silver Tail

scenes.caption: Poki's quiet silver visit by the backyard fence.
scenes.alt: Under a deep blue twilight sky with the first stars, six-year-old Clara crouches in her yellow raincoat by the wooden backyard fence as sleek, glossy dark costume-free cat Poki glows softly in silver starlight and gently taps one white-tipped paw onto the smooth white pebble in her hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Great Spanish House Trap

scenes.caption: Measuring Señor Flashy Suit's 'wide green estate' with real tools.
scenes.alt: Beside a tiny dusty weedy lot in Spain, Jorge crouches with a yellow tape measure and tablet map while Clara peeks over his shoulder, Marissa looks on skeptically with crossed arms, Garbanzo pokes out of Jorge's backpack, and a flashy blue-suited agent in sunglasses gestures nervously beside a glossy brochure.

scenes.caption: Match point off the back glass in sunny Valladolid.
scenes.alt: On a sunny blue glass-walled padel court in Valladolid, Jorge dives to whip a yellow ball off the back glass against two grinning local neighbors while Marissa, Clara, and tiny Garbanzo peeking from a sports bag cheer joyfully from the sidelines.

scenes.caption: Fixing the Double-Counting Bug during the January storm.
scenes.alt: During a rainy January night in the New Jersey dining room, Jorge uses a miniature screwdriver and laptop cable to debug tiny Garbanzo amid scattered folders and pink confetti while Marissa holds a flashlight and sleepy Clara looks on in red flannel pajamas and purple unicorn socks.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Hardest Friday of All
Chapter 9: Twelve Dragons and One Big Stew

scenes.caption: Twelve plush dragons burst free before Aunt Lidia's farewell feast.
scenes.alt: Amid stacked moving boxes in the hallway, Clara's overstuffed pink suitcase bursts open on the stairs in a comical shower of colorful plush dragons, unicorn headbands, and socks while Clara dives to catch a pink dragon, Jorge laughs in surprise, and Aunt Lidia stirs a steaming pot of cocido in the warm kitchen beyond.

scenes.caption: Tuesday evening in Valladolid: unhurried dinner and a quiet friend on the warm brick wall.
scenes.alt: At golden dusk outside their white one-story Valladolid home with solar panels and a glowing patio lantern, Jorge, Marissa, and Clara laugh slowly over dinner while Garbanzo sits calmly on the table with zero confetti and sleek, glossy dark costume-free Poki rests peacefully in soft silver light atop the warm red brick garden wall.
